urdu transliteration:
Sadaa Ye Aati Hai Maqtalse Meri Jaan Asghar
Tumhaare Hijrmen Betaab Hai Ye Maa Asghar
english translation text:
A cry comes from the battlefield, my beloved Asghar.
Your mother longs for you in your absence, Asghar.

urdu transliteration:
Ab Aabhi Jaao Bari Der Hogai Betaa
Gae Ho Ruthke Maadarse Tum Kahaan Asghar
english translation text:
Come back now, my son, it has been far too long.
Where have you gone after leaving your mother, Asghar?

urdu transliteration:
Padarke Paas Jo Soe To Hamko Bhul Gae
Na Yaad Aai Tumhe Dil Jali Ye Maa Asghar
english translation text:
You fell asleep beside your father and forgot about me.
Did your grief-stricken mother not come to your mind, Asghar?

urdu transliteration:
Woh Ek Nannaasa Julaa Bhi Jal Gayaa Betaa
Tumhaare Baad Jo Baaqi Thaa Ek Nishaan Asghar
english translation text:
Even your little cradle was burned, my son.
It was the only sign of you that remained, Asghar.

urdu transliteration:
Ridaaen Chhin Gai Be Pardaa Ham Phiraae Gae
Issi Tarahse Na Jaane Kahaan Kahaan Asghar
english translation text:
Our veils were snatched and we were paraded unveiled.
Who knows through how many places we were taken, Asghar?

urdu transliteration:
Bahan Tumhaari Sakinaape Zulm Or Huwe
Hai Uske Kaan Abhi Tak Lahu Lahaan Asgher
english translation text:
Your sister Sakina suffered even more oppression.
Her ears are still stained with blood, Asghar.

urdu transliteration:
Chalebhi Aawo Ke Tanhaai Khaae Jaati Hai
Sulaaungi Tumhe De Deke Loriyaan Asghar
english translation text:
Come back now, for this loneliness is consuming me.
I will sing you lullabies until you fall asleep, Asghar.
